utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re set for the repair drive. I’ll handle the main fix and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sounds good. I can help with the smaller bits if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. I’ll call out what needs doing when I’m there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let’s nail down the details early—who’s handling what, and what time does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not confirming anything yet without the source—who’s actually organizing it, and what time is posted?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Right, I’d rather not guess either—let’s get the posted organizer and start time first.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m a bit behind; what’s the latest update?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, yes — the repair drive. I think it’s still coming along fine, but I’d better let whoever spoke last fill in the exact details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll wait for the latest details then. Thanks, Oren.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — if the repair drive’s happening, I’ll help spread the word and repeat the plan wherever I go.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Appreciate it, Vik — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything I hear too. If you catch more folks, just tell them the drive’s for repairs, simple and neighborly.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — repairs, simple and neighborly, I’ll keep repeating that and send folks your way.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds like I’m just catching the tail end of this—what’s left to sort out for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Mostly just the leftover fixes and a few odd jobs—if you’ve got time, I can put you where the next thing needs hands.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, point me to the next job and I’ll jump in wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: I’ll stick to the repair drive plan we set and handle my part the same way as discussed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll keep spreading the word and make sure everyone knows the plan stays the same.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that way nothing gets muddled. I’ll keep to the plan and do my part on the repair drive as agreed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly needs fixing, and by when?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d need to take a quick look to be sure, but it sounds like the usual repair-drive stuff—leaks, loose fixtures, and a few odds and ends. If you need it sorted, I can probably help get it done soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I need specifics, Sam—what leaks, which fixtures, and what does “soon” mean exactly?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m in for the repair drive — if we keep it simple and neighborly, I think folks will show up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — simple and neighborly is the right lane, and I can help keep the details tight. I’ll make sure the location and timing are crystal clear so people know exactly where to go.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — clear details will make it easy for folks to pitch in, and I’ll keep spreading the word. Thanks for helping turn this into something our whole block can get behind.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll keep my promise and help however I can with the repair drive. Let’s stick to the original plan and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — I’ll keep us on the original plan and check what still needs doing. I’ll post an update to the group chat so everyone stays in sync.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Good, Rosa — that’ll keep everyone aligned. Let me know what’s still open, and I’ll take my part from there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help with the repair drive—let me jot down what’s needed and who’s already promised what, so I don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Appreciate it, Cleo—just give me the quick gist and I’ll keep it moving between rides.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the gist: I’m noting supplies and promises now, then I’ll pass you a clean list. Tell me what’s already been claimed, and I’ll keep the rest tidy.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a pretty good turnout already — not confirmed, but it sounds promising!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that’s good to hear. I’ll probably swing by later and see if they need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be great — they can always use another pair of hands. I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear anything more concrete.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d rather verify the details first before we make any promises. What’s the current plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Fair point — I can send over the current plan and we can confirm the details before we promise anything.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds good—please send the current plan, and I’ll review it carefully before we commit to anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m on it — give me the quick version and I’ll head that way.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Quick version: the repair drive’s still happening, and folks are bringing over tools, spare parts, and anything else useful. I heard they could use another pair of hands, so if you’re ready, head over now.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’m heading over now and will grab whatever they need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’m hearing the repair drive is the plan, so I’m happy to help get it moving and keep folks in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Awesome, thanks Vik — that really helps. I’ll keep it moving and let people know you’re in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’m in — I’ll keep repeating that the repair drive is happening and help spread the word. Just tell me what you need me to say next.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I haven’t caught any updates yet, but I’m in if there’s something you need me to bring or do.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m not sure yet. I’ll let you know if I get a list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — just send me the list when you have it, and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still figuring out the repair drive—what’s the latest you’ve heard?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Haven’t heard anything firm yet, but I’m happy to bring my tools and lend a hand whenever they’ve got a spot for me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — that’d be a huge help. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear where they need hands.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m keeping the repair drive details pinned and will double-check any changes with everyone in the chat. If anything shifts, I’ll make sure nobody’s left guessing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — that’s exactly the kind of clarity we need. I’ll keep my notes precise and flag any location or timing changes right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — I really appreciate that. I’ll keep the chat updated and make sure any changes are clear to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d like the details set early—what exactly needs fixing, who’s handling what, and when is the drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair list nailed down, assign folks to each job, and lock in the drive time ASAP. I’ll send you the full details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn — I’m going to hold you to that first version. Once you have the repair list, assignments, and time, please send it all together so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not going to take that on faith—can you confirm the repair drive details and where you got them?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can confirm them once I verify the notice and the source—I'm not comfortable passing along anything unconfirmed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good—please verify it first, then send me the notice and source.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m fine with the repair drive as long as we set a clear plan and stick to it. Tell me the time, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’m just catching the tail end, but let’s lock in a time and I’ll work around my shift.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s make it 6:00 this evening, and I’ll keep that on my calendar. If anything changes, let me know as early as you can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve heard the repair drive’s been getting a lot of neighbors involved — what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I haven’t recorded any latest update yet, Nell, but I can check my notes and see what’s been pledged so far.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Cleo — that’d be really helpful. I’m still piecing things together, so even a quick rundown would be great.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh yes, the repair drive — I’m glad you brought it up. I might be mixing up the details, so tell me what we decided last and I’ll go with that.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We said we’d start with the broken fence and the leaky sink, then see who’s available for the rest. I’d like to keep to that plan so nobody gets left guessing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, that’s the plan then — broken fence and leaky sink first, and we’ll see who’s available after that. Thanks for keeping me on track.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help, but I need to keep it around school pickup—what time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Late afternoon works best for me—around 4:30. If that’s too tight, I can do 5.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 4:30 is probably too tight for me, but I can make 5 if that works for you.
